Validate exact owner task/run/agent identities, bounded fresh observations, terminal coherence, and mutually exclusive candidate/accepted/rejected/conflicting task-id sets before returning a fresh per-request copy. Keep generic runtime database readiness unavailable and make no independent liveness or completion claim in the provider.

interface_mismatches: CampaignSnapshot serializes owner_executions and verdict task-id sets, but the secure validator currently discards every outer field after validating only mission_snapshot.
MissionSnapshot receipts cannot be relabeled as campaign independent acceptance; the consumer needs the supervisor's already-validated verdict sets.
Generic runtime routes use a mission-prefixed session domain that cannot resolve Orchestrator owner sessions and may initialize databases; runtime_projection_mode must remain unavailable.
A candidate result, an accepted result, and a current owner observation are different epistemic modalities and must remain separate fields.
honest_blockers: The read model is same-UID and self-digested, not independently signed or a canonical state owner.
Fresh owner observation can support bounded current-motion language only; it cannot establish usefulness or completion.
The provider cannot create owner runs or acceptances and never upgrades its own proves_executor_liveness claim.
Constellation consumption is separately owned and remains absent until its own Organism packet lands.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the validator/provider extension, focused tests, and tracked packet. The API resumes returning only mission_snapshot, generic runtime database readiness remains unavailable, and canonical owners are untouched.
